verdict.rationale: Operating an email platform through natural-language commands is a fair question for a SaaS like SendGrid, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only programmatic control (REST API, SDKs, SMTP, webhooks) and a UI dashboard. The llms.txt and markdown-docs probes show the docs are machine-readable for LLMs, but that is not the same as accepting natural-language commands. No evidence shows an AI assistant, NL interface, or agent integration for operating the product.
